generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non- accessibility of KPPP portals due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted online in KPPP portal
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the date of opening
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection
The bidder shall obtain Workmen compensatory insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work
The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc.,
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates
The bidder shall upload/submit online duly signed copy of Form of Tender and Declaration by Bidder formats under Section 3 of bid document
Bidders should have an independent PF code. The bidder shall remit PF of labourers to Contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only
Any revision in GST rates during execution of work will be paid to the contractor by KPCL or recovered from the bills of the contractor
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (Gates)S, KPC Ltd., Kargal, Sagara Tq 577421

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five financial years satisfactorily completed, as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Maintenance/Servicing/fabrication/reconditioning of Gates/Hoists pertaining to Dams/power house of single order value not less than Rs 8.10 lakhs. In proof of the above, a copy of work done certificate issued from the competent authority & the corresponding work order shall be furnished. (Note: The value of completed works shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited).

As a proof, the bidder shall furnish Turnover certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Operation & Routine maintenance of various hydro-mechanical equipments of Linganamakki dam, Bhadra dam and appurtenant works for the period of 7.5 months

itemList.description:
Cleaning & Lubrication of all parts of hoists, moving parts of radial gates and washing of gate elements using high pressure washer at Linganamakki dam.
(Refer detailed scope work in the bid document)

Resetting of sluice gates rollers at Linganamakki dam including cost of labour, welding, gas cutting, grinding, dismantling and re assembling etc.
(Refer detailed scope work in the bid document)

Cleaning & Lubrication of all parts of gantries & its connected elements and washing of equipments using high pressure washer as directed at Sharavathy valley project, Bhadra hydro-electric project.
(Refer detailed scope work in the bid document)

Cleaning & Lubrication of all parts of fixed rope drum hoists & its connected elements as directed at Sharavathy valley project, Bhadra hydro-electric project.
(Refer detailed scope work in the bid document)

Cleaning & Lubrication of all parts of service gate/stoplog elements & its connected elements and washing of equipments using high pressure washer as directed at Sharavathy valley project, Bhadra hydro-electric project.
(Refer detailed scope work in the bid document)

Servicing of control panel and other electrical connections and replacement of defective parts/spares(excluding spares) at Linganamakki dam, vodenbyle & Bhadra hydro-electric project.
(Refer detailed scope work in the bid document)

Replacement of defective contactors/coil/relays, cost of electrician, tools etc., at Linganamakki dam, vodenbyle & Bhadra hydro-electric project.
(Refer detailed scope work in the bid document)

Breakdown maintenance of motor Capacity, 10HP and below pertaining to hydromechanical equipments. The work includes decoupling, dismantling, lifting, lowering, arrangements of motor, Repair/servicing of motor, assembling of motor,alignment,replacement of defective bearings, fasteners, varnishing etc., , at Linganamakki dam, MGHE forebay and Kargal Anicut, vodenbyle & Bhadra hydro-elctric project as and when required.
(Refer detailed scope work in the bid document)

Breakdown maintenance of motor capacity, 20 HP to 35HP pertaining to hydromechanical equipments. The work includes decoupling, dismantling, lifting, lowering, arrangements of motor, Repair/servicing of motor, assembling of motor,alignment,replacement of defective bearings, fasteners, varnishing etc., , at Linganamakki dam, MGHE forebay and Kargal Anicut, vodenbyle & Bhadra hydro-elctric project as and when required.
(Refer detailed scope work in the bid document)

Operation and daily routine maintenance of hydro mechanical equipments of Linganamakki dam.
(Refer detailed scope work in the bid document)

Attending emergency repair works such as replacement of wire ropes, arisen at Linganamakki dam as and when required, including cost of labour welding, cutting ,grinding., dismantling etc.,(wire rope will be provided departmentally, remaining all work needed for replacement of new wire rope including releasing and transporting the material to store )

Removing damaged rubber seal from gate and fixing new rubber seal (excluding cost of rubber seal and fasteners ) including cleaning seal seat, valcanizing seal wherever necessary, forming holes in seal, fixing in place & all necessary works as directed and complete as per specification

Provision towards payment of wages for general holidays (7 days)and Leave with wages (9 days)for manpower engaged in operation and routine maintenance works of hydro mechanical equipments at Linganamakki dam - for 7.5 months
